title: You too Brutus! Trapping Hateful Users in Social Media: Challenges, Solutions & Insights
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical detection of hateful users on social media using Graph Neural Networks and text-based features. While it analyzes target communities of hate speech, including religious groups (Jews, Muslims), and contains a brief section on 'Ethical considerations' regarding data privacy, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as primary research components.
